parameters.name: ApplicationId
parameters.description: The ID of the application that you want to modify.

parameters.name: AuthorizationType
parameters.description:
The authorization type of the application. Valid values:

*   authorize_required: Only the user with explicit authorization can access the application.
*   default_all: By default, all users can access the application.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun eiam update-application-authorization-type --instance-id idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --application-id app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --authorization-type authorize_required --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun eiam UpdateApplicationAuthorizationType --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceId idaas_ue2jvisn35ea5lmthk267xxxxx --ApplicationId app_mkv7rgt4d7i4u7zqtzev2mxxxx --AuthorizationType authorize_required
